catalog_default_note: The catalog specifies default_node_settings.timeout_seconds = 10 and retry_attempts = 0. Version 87 explicitly exports retryAttempts = 0 for every webhook but exports none of timeout, timeout_seconds, or timeoutSeconds. Observed read calls lasted roughly 18 to 24 seconds and the measured /sign 502 arrived at about 28.2 seconds, while the patient reply gap was 48.2 seconds across surrounding processing. Therefore the 10-second catalog value is intended configuration, not demonstrated runtime behavior; the Bland platform default and exact per-node client cutoff cannot be determined from this export.
